defaultValue: The hour as one large numeral. A minute hand sweeps clockwise from twelve, leaving a trail of minute marks behind it — and the part of the numeral it has already swept past is dimmed. At the top of the hour everything resets.

items.defaultValue: The dimmed part of the numeral is not a separate setting: it is mixed from the two colours above. Pebble renders only four levels per colour channel, so pick two colours with plenty of contrast — otherwise the dimmed segment collapses into the background and the effect is lost.

items.label: 24-hour clock
items.description: Off shows the hour as 1 to 12. Either way the hour is shown without a leading zero.
